learn.learn.title: Learn
learn.learn.sub: Memorise a surah, grow its tree
learn.learn.walletAria: {n} Light to spend. Open the seed store
learn.learn.noSurahHere: No surah starts in this juz
learn.learn.canvasAria: The Juz {n} garden: {planted} trees planted. The trees button lists each tree.
learn.learn.how1: Plant a surah’s seed: the first seed of every surah is free. Drag it onto any square.
learn.learn.how2: Each lesson learns a small part: 1, 2 or 3 ayat, half a page or a page, as you choose. Listen, practise, then recite it from memory.
learn.learn.how3: Then link it: recite everything learned so far from the first ayah. The tree grows with every part.
learn.learn.how4: The tree is full grown once you recite the whole surah from memory in one go.
learn.learn.how5: Trees get thirsty after 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days, then every month. Recite the surah to water it, so it stays with you.
learn.learn.trayHint: Press the seed, drag it and let go on a square
learn.learn.dragSeed: press and drag it onto your garden
learn.learn.dragTitle: Press a seed and drag it into your garden
learn.learn.dragHow: Hold it, move it over a free square, let go. Or tap it to keep it ready below the garden.
learn.learn.trayAuto: Plant it on the nearest free square, or drag it onto one
learn.learn.gardenFull: This garden is full: move something away first
learn.learn.stThirsty: Thirsty: recite it to water it
learn.learn.stWhole: Every ayah learned: recite it whole to grow it full
learn.learn.stSeed: A seed: start the first lesson
learn.learn.waterSub: Recite the whole surah from memory
learn.learn.wholeSub: Recite the whole surah from memory
learn.learn.allWateredSub: Plant a new seed, or come back when a tree is thirsty.
learn.learn.toPlaceN: {n} decorations wait to be placed: find them under your garden.
learn.learn.goReview: Water it: recite what you learned
learn.learn.dragHint: Hold and drag it to move it anywhere in the garden.
learn.learn.unplantAsk: Take this tree out of the garden? What you learned stays with the surah.
learn.learn.earnHow: Earned by learning, reading and meeting your goals
learn.learn.seedsSub: One tree for each surah, in the garden of the juz where it starts.
learn.learn.insideSurah: This juz is part of {name}: its tree grows in the Juz {n} garden.
